title: Discrete wave turbulence for a coupled system of quintic Schrödinger equations
summary: We derive rigorously the non-linear macroscopic system associated to a microscopic system of coupled quintic Schrödinger equations in the framework of discrete wave turbulence under a particular scaling law that describes the limiting process. Our system evolves from a pair of well-prepared random initial data. More precisely, in dimensions $d\geq2$, we set up our microscopic system on a large box of size $L$ with weak non-linearity of strength $ε$.
